 : Nagpur Bench : Nagpur

sentences.text:
Coram : G. A. Sanap, J.
Date : October 19, 2023.
1.  Heard Mr. A. M. Chandekar, learned advocate for the applicant and Mr. K. R. Lule, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the non-applicant/State.
Perused the record and proceedings.

2. The applicant/accused no.5, who was arrested in Crime No. 319/2022, registered with Police Station, Chimur, Dist. Chandrapur for the offences under Sections 406, 408, 409, 420, 465, 467,
468, 471, 477(A), 120B, 201 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3 of the Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (in Financial Establishments) Act, 1999 (for short "the MPID Act"

entities.text: Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (in Financial Establishments) Act, 1999
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: ), has made this application for bail.

3. Learned advocate for the applicant/accused no.5 submitted that in terms of the order of this Court (Coram :
M. W. Chandwani, J.) dated 10.10.2023, the accused has deposited the amount of Rs.
1,59,480/-, which was allegedly misappropriated by him.
Learned advocate submitted that the accused, by depositing the amount, has shown his bona fides.
It is submitted that after completion 2 42 ba907.23.odt of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Learned advocate further submitted that the role of accused no.5 is Anil S/O. Bhaurao Nannaware vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso, Ps Chimur, Dist. ...

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:

1 separate and distinct from the role of accused nos.1 to 4.
Learned advocate submitted that detention of accused no.5 is not necessary for the purpose of further investigation.
It is submitted that the accused is ready to abide by the conditions that may be imposed by this Court.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that considering the amount of misappropriation involved in the case by all the accused, no case has been made out to release accused no.5 on bail.
It is submitted that the possibility of the accused pressurizing the witnesses cannot be ruled out, if he is released on bail.
5. Accused no.5 was working as a pigmi agent of Rashtrasant Tukdoji Sahakari Nagari Pat Sanstha Maryadit, Chimur.

entities.text: Rashtrasant Tukdoji Sahakari Nagari Pat Sanstha Maryadit
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: Accused nos.1 to 4 are the office bearers of the said society.

It is the case of the prosecution that accused no.5, after collection of money from the customers/ members, had not deposited the said amount in the respective accounts of the customers and as such misappropriated a sum of Rs.1,59,480/-.
Accused no.5 was not involved in the day to day management and business of the society.
Accused no.5, in order to show his bona fides, has deposited the amount alleged to have been misappropriated by him.
In my view, considering this fact, the applicant/ accused no.5 can be released on bail.
The apprehension placed on record by learned APP can be taken care of by imposing appropriate conditions.
6. Accordingly, the criminal application is allowed.

Applicant - Anil S/o Bhaurao Nannaware be released on bail in Crime No. 319/2022, registered with Police Station, Chimur, Dist. Chandrapur, on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five thousand only) with one surety in the like amount.
8. The applicant/accused shall not threaten or pressurize the prosecution witnesses and shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
9. He shall attend the trial Court proceeding on each and every date and cooperate in conducting the trial.

10. The application stands disposed of.
